_about: Tables for body/BODY.md, the integration hub: the shared character body record, the capability outputs STATS.md and COMBAT.md read, the overnight tick order, the states of being as physiological profiles, and the interaction chains the dashboard lets Rex inspect. mark: rex | proposed | open.

record.title: The shared body record (one per active character; the fields each subsystem owns)
record.source: ChatGPT's principle, agreed by the combat keeper and the brief: one shared character state, specialised modules; each subsystem computes its own values, BODY.md combines them (proposed, outside AI). Field names are the keeper's.
rows: sex, age, height_cm, personality type, genetic min and max per attribute (per limb: open)
per arm and leg: groups[] (development, fatigue, condition, stimulus), wounds[], caps (permanent), present (false after amputation)
fitness, cardioFatigue, aerobic_today, sleepDebt, alertness, coreTemp, waterDeficit, fatigueDay, heatAcclim, seaLegs
glycogen, fatMass, leanMass, fullness, hunger, appetite (per meal offered), energyBalance, pools{vit_c, b1, b3, a, iron, folate, b12, sodium, potassium, magnesium, zinc, ...}
rex (that they exist), proposed (fields; the fullness/hunger/appetite split on Rex's go-ahead 2026-10-29)
conditions[] (id, stage, day, severity), bloodLoss, pain, immunity{}

per organ: function, damage; per tissue: integrity; the blood: volume, plasma, redCellMass, Hb, SaO2, CO, DO2, MAP, perfusion{organ}, platelets, clotting, Na, K, Ca, Mg, glucose, pH, lactate, immune, lipids, atherosclerosis index

per system: tone, sensitivity; per substance: concentration, dependence, withdrawal; habits{}; burdens{mercury, lead}; the circuit outputs (arousal, coordination, attention, encoding, painRelief, breathing, moodBias, fear, appetiteMod, sleepQuality)
mood, madness, hearts, respect, sliders, trust, memories

capabilities.title: The capability outputs: the only numbers STATS.md and COMBAT.md read from the body
capabilities.source: Rex: physical attributes per limb; Endurance, Constitution, Agility whole-body; the function attributes in the head; hit locations dip what they house; Endurance the pool, Efficiency the spend (COMBAT.md 4a, 6a). STATS.md 4: performance = skill x attribute factor (today) x state. The formulas are the keeper's combination of the subsystem outputs.
rows: Strength_attr(limb) x forceAvailable(limb) x woundDip(limb) x coldFactor x hydrationFactor(Strength) x capFactor(limb). One pathway per impairment: forceAvailable carries muscle fatigue and muscle condition (MUSCULAR, strains); woundDip carries MEDICINE wounds (cuts, fractures, gunshot) and never also sets a muscle's condition; a wound to a limb counts once. Strength_attr computed from the limb's groups at full rest if Rex picks 'compute' (MUSCULAR 8), else stored

Dexterity_attr(limb) x woundDip(limb) x coldFactor(Dex) x painFactor(limb) x drinkFactor (= NEUROLOGY coordination and arousal outputs once that file stands; the STATS drink state until then) x muscleFatigueCap(limb). painFactor is pain's own pathway (coordination); the injury itself reaches Dexterity only through woundDip
Reflexes_attr(limb) x alertness x drinkFactor (= NEUROLOGY coordination and arousal outputs once that file stands; the STATS drink state until then) x woundDip(limb) x coldFactor
MUSCULAR 8 movement row: the weaker leg limits; x alertness x heatState x load
ceiling x (1 - 0.5 fatigueDay) x alertness x hydrationFactor x glycogenFactor x feverFactor x bloodFactor (CIRCULATION: the class and the oxygen delivery) x heatFactor
Efficiency_attr (Te): untouched by the body except alertness x (Rex: the spend is Efficiency's; the keeper proposes only that exhaustion makes a character waste motion: x alertness, open)
Constitution_attr x bloodFactor x nutritionFactor x torsoWoundDip

Agility_attr x legsFactor (the worse leg's woundDip) x balanceFactor (glute_med, deep_core forceAvailable) x alertness x drinkFactor (= NEUROLOGY coordination and arousal outputs once that file stands; the STATS drink state until then) x seaLegs
Head attributes today (Eyesight Si, Perception Se, Pattern Recognition Ne, Hearing Fe, Intuition Ni, Spatial Reasoning Ti, Wits, Memory, Taste and smell)

attr x alertness x headWoundDip x feverFactor x (Eyesight: light from the map, COMBAT 6; night blindness from vitamin A). alertness already contains the circadian factor (PHYSIOLOGY 3); it is never applied twice
Poise_attr x painFactor? (open: Rex's Poise resists flinching from strikes; whether pain feeds it is MEDICINE open 3)
Nerve_attr x alertness x drinkFactor (= NEUROLOGY coordination and arousal outputs once that file stands; the STATS drink state until then)(+) (rum raises Nerve read, NUTRITION boosts: fiction, open)
min over the duty's activation groups of (force available / force required) x (1 - 0.5 fatigueDay) x heatState x alertness; fatigueDay is 0 fresh and 1 exhausted, so the factor falls from 1.0 to 0.5

mood x madness x drink only, each mapped to 0.5 to 1.0; computed here once. Fatigue, sickness and injury are NOT in state: they already reach performance through the attributes-today above (one pathway per impairment), so STATS 4's list of six becomes three here, the other three carried by the attribute factor
the crew engine (mood, madness), this file (drink)
proposed (STATS 4 proposed the shape; the split is the keeper's)
Accident chance (a fall, a burn, a cut)
base(place hazard, ENVIRONMENT) x (2 - alertness) x (1 + fatigueDay) x drinkFactor (= NEUROLOGY coordination and arousal outputs once that file stands; the STATS drink state until then)(-) x seaState
Appearance (the visible face for the art keeper)
build (lean mass, fat mass), scars and missing parts, pallor (blood, anaemia), jaundice, sunburn, sweat, bandages

tick.title: The overnight tick: order of integration
tick.source: The game's day loop (PIRATE.md 5) and the alignment engine's sleep (ALIGNMENT.md 5): the town transforms at the same sleep. Order chosen so each step reads only finished inputs.
rows: tomorrow's weather drawn; tonight's exposure (wet, cold, mosquitoes) for where each character sleeps
stocks, fields and settlements advance one day (the visited town) or a batch (distant ones)
sleep blocks from the roster; sleep debt and alertness; core temperature overnight; Banister decay plus the day's load; whole-body fatigue reset
the day's meals summed; energy balance settled into fat and glycogen; nutrient pools filled or drained; deficiency clocks advanced; spoilage
fatigue recovers by 3CC R overnight; stimulus converts to development where the rest, protein and energy gates allow; disuse decay; DOMS
exposure rolls (catching); conditions advance (incubation, course, death rolls); wounds heal by their modified clock; infection and sepsis rolls; blood regenerates
capabilities recomputed from the new states; permanent caps applied
pushes on mood, madness, respect and the sliders handed to the crew engine
the crew engine and the town engine
their own sleep: moods, madness acts, the town's transformations (ALIGNMENT.md 5); the waking screen's events (a sail torn, a crew mate sick: DUTIES.md morning events)

states_of_being.title: States of being as physiological profiles on the same architecture
states_of_being.source: Rex (COMBAT.md 4e, 2026-10-29): resurrection by faction ends the storyline and gives a stronger, frozen form: Atlanteans a mecha AI (memories, thoughts, beliefs frozen; mecha upgrades), the ghost faction a ghost, free pirates a voodoo zombie, Imperials an angel, merfolk undecided; the Cthulhu cult makes a fish person, the devil cult a demon, a chaotic-evil kidnapping leaves them missing; ghosts have their own physiological needs and desires. Each form as a profile on the body architecture is ChatGPT's (proposed, outside AI). The profile contents below are the keeper's placeholders for the story keeper and Rex.
rows: food, water, salt: all of NUTRITION
the Ghost Fleet, or death by the ghost rule
'ghosts have their own physiological needs and desires' (Rex): proposed a need for attachment (a place, a person, an unfinished thing) that drains like hunger
no disease; no bleeding; 'wounds' are dispersal, recovered by returning to the attachment
frozen at death (Rex); reads only the pushes that touch its attachment
passes walls (COMBAT 6: a detection and movement rule, combat keeper's); cannot carry
power: a charge the Atlanteans sell or a sun-fed cell (fiction, open)
overheats under heavy work (a heatState of its own); cold-proof
no disease; damage is wear, repaired with parts (an economy good, open), not healed
no muscle: fixed strength per limb, upgraded by parts (Rex: mecha upgrades)
memories, thoughts, beliefs frozen (Rex); no mood pushes
strength and senses by upgrade; immune to fatigue
ritual upkeep (ChatGPT): a rite each week by a houngan, else decay
no pain, no shock; rots: a decay clock in place of healing; no disease
fixed; cannot train; does not tire
'divine energy by alignment' (ChatGPT): drains when acting against the orderly good, refills in a church
immune; heals fast; harmed by the unholy (fiction)
'infernal sustenance' (ChatGPT): a need the story keeper writes
memories kept, wants otherwise? (ChatGPT's question; Rex's mecha answer settles only the Atlanteans)
strength, fear (Poise damage on others, combat keeper's)
the Cthulhu cult transforms them; the INTJ's test subjects
fish; must stay wet (NUTRITION water inverted: dries out of water, a hydration clock in reverse)
heals in water; period diseases of the sea (none modelled); wounds normal
frozen if it came by death; living if transformed alive (ChatGPT: a transformation need not be a death)
swims, breathes water, sees in the dark (Eyesight at night)
the Criminal Pirates or any chaotic-evil kidnapper
no ghost; the person is gone; whether they can return is the story keeper's

chains.title: Interaction chains the dashboard lets Rex inspect
chains.source: The brief's five chains plus the ones the docs make: each step names the doc, the variable and the direction, so a reader can follow a cause to a capability.
rows: NUTRITION: protein g/kg and energy balance -> MUSCULAR: conversion gate (x1.0 at 1.6 g/kg; x0.5 at 0.8; x0.1 at 0.4) -> development per group -> BODY: Strength_today(limb) -> STATS: every skill reading Strength; COMBAT: effort required per action

watch roster: hours slept -> PHYSIOLOGY: sleep debt, alertness -> MUSCULAR: sleep gate on conversion (x0.3 under 4 h) and R rest multiplier -> MEDICINE: healing x1.2 over 24 h debt -> BODY: Reflexes, head attributes, accident chance -> PSYCHOLOGY: mood -1/day, Volatile pressure

ENVIRONMENT: WBGT at the place -> PHYSIOLOGY: sweat rate 0.3 to 2.5 L/h, core drift -> waterDeficit % -> hydration thresholds (2%: Endurance x0.85) -> NUTRITION: sodium pool -1 g per litre -> MUSCULAR: cramp; MEDICINE: heat exhaustion, heat stroke -> BODY: Endurance pool, work capacity

MEDICINE: exposure (hygiene x season x place) -> catch roll -> condition stage -> feverFactor, appetite x0.5, hydration drain -> NUTRITION: intake down, pools drain -> PHYSIOLOGY: alertness, aerobic x0.8 (anaemia) -> BODY: Endurance pool, work capacity, head attributes -> PSYCHOLOGY: mood -2/day; the surgeon's report

COMBAT: hit location and damage -> MEDICINE: wound (kind, severity, bleeding class, pain) -> dips on the housed stats (Rex: arm, leg, head, torso) -> bleeding drains the Endurance pool per turn; pain and blood trigger shock (Nerve) -> BODY: Strength/Dexterity/Reflexes_today(limb), movement, head attributes -> COMBAT: accuracy, parry, movement; after: healing clock, infection, permanent caps

GOODS: stores with no fresh food -> NUTRITION: vitamin C pool 1,500 mg draining 3%/day -> day 40 to 60: PSYCHOLOGY mood -1/day (lassitude) -> day 60 to 90: MEDICINE scurvy stage 2 (bleeding gums in dialogue; healing x3; old wounds reopen) -> day 90+: stage 3, death rolls -> a port with limes: pool refills, fit in a week

DUTIES: a season on the pumps -> PHYSIOLOGY: MET-hours -> Banister fitness (42-day) and fatigue (7-day) -> aerobic_today -> Endurance pool ceiling; MUSCULAR: the pumping profile -> back, arms, grip development

ENVIRONMENT: a gale -> PIRATE 5a: all hands, sail wear, leaks -> no sleep (PHYSIOLOGY debt), wet cold nights (core temperature), falls x3 (MEDICINE fractures) -> BODY: next day's work capacity down while the pumps need it most

PHYSIOLOGY ageing: the maximum of each attribute falls on its curve -> STATS: the current value capped -> MUSCULAR: conversion x0.6 at 60 -> MEDICINE: healing x1.3 over 50 -> but skills never fall (Rex): the old surgeon

POPULATION: an epidemic in a town the crew visited -> MEDICINE: exposure for whoever was there -> a named character's fate: NOT this family's to write; the event is handed to the fate owners (BALANCE C5 32)

GOODS: a gill of rum -> NEUROLOGY 3: 14 g alcohol absorbed over 30 to 90 min, cleared at 0.015 g/dL per hour -> gaba tone up, glutamate down, dopamine and opioid up (x the drinker's sensitivity) -> circuits: motor control down (BODY: Dexterity, Agility, the accident roll: Rex's 'too much rum, accidents'), fear down (COMBAT Nerve: Dutch courage), encoding down over 0.08 g/dL (the memories system records nothing), sleep quality x0.7 (PHYSIOLOGY), mood bias + then - (PSYCHOLOGY) -> nightly for 3 weeks: gaba sensitivity falls (tolerance), dependence rises -> a dry passage: withdrawal (tremor, no sleep, fits at 24 to 48 h, delirium at 48 to 72 h: MEDICINE condition) -> the craving push (PSYCHOLOGY) and the habit the story keeper can write
Scurvy through the tissues (the organ-layer chain)

GOODS: no fresh food -> NUTRITION 5: vitamin C pool under 300 mg (day 53) -> ANATOMY 2: connective tissue integrity falls 0.02 a day (collagen cannot cross-link) -> CIRCULATION: vessel walls leak (bruises; gums bleed; blood volume trickles) -> MEDICINE: every wound's healing x3, old scars reopen (the tissue, not a scurvy rule) -> BODY: Constitution and the pool through the blood factor; PSYCHOLOGY: lassitude from day 36 -> limes: the pool refills, integrity rebuilds over 2 to 4 weeks
The old captain's heart (a conditional event)

forty years of pipe and salt pork -> CIRCULATION: lipids and tobacco damage the endothelium (ANATOMY tissues) -> the atherosclerosis index climbs with age (x2 at 70) -> coronary perfusion narrows: angina on the stairs (face) -> a cold morning hauling with the crew (trigger x5) -> plaque rupture, a clot: infarction (index^2 x 0.001 x 5 that day) -> ANATOMY: heart function 0.4, damage +0.3 for good; CIRCULATION: output down -> kidneys, the dropsy -> MEDICINE names heart failure; the story keeper has an ending that was never a scripted death

visible_faces.source: Rex: stats are secret; the player infers them from conversation, gossip and watching people work (PIRATE.md 7b). Every mechanic in the family names its face; this table is the index.

'Jimmie fixed James's leg'; 'that port has the fever'
